namespace {

    #ifdef TRISC_MATH
    inline void silu_fn(uint32_t a, uint32_t b, uint32_t out) {
        for (int rows = 0; rows < 8; rows++) {
            sfpi::vFloat t0 = sfpi::dst_reg[a * 32];
            sfpi::vFloat t1 = ckernel::sfpu::_sfpu_sigmoid_<DST_ACCUM_MODE>(t0);
            sfpi::vFloat t2 = t0 * t1;
            if constexpr (!DST_ACCUM_MODE) {
                t2 = float32_to_bf16_rne(t2);
            }
            sfpi::dst_reg[out * 32] = t2;
            sfpi::dst_reg++;
        }
    }
    #endif

}  // namespace

// Common arguments: tiles_base, tiles_extra.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr uint32_t cb_x0 = 0, cb_out = 16;
    const uint32_t tiles_base = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t tiles_extra = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t count = tiles_base + (core < tiles_extra ? 1 : 0);
    compute_kernel_hw_startup(cb_x0, cb_x0, cb_out);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        cb_wait_front(cb_x0, 1);
        tile_regs_acquire();
        copy_init(cb_x0);
        copy_tile(cb_x0, 0, 0);
        silu_tile_init();
        MATH((_llk_math_eltwise_binary_sfpu_params_(silu_fn, 0, 0, 0, VectorMode::RC)));
        tile_regs_commit();
        tile_regs_wait();
        cb_reserve_back(cb_out, 1);
        pack_tile(0, cb_out);
        tile_regs_release();
        cb_push_back(cb_out, 1);
        cb_pop_front(cb_x0, 1);
    }
}
